name: Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) — 44 U.S.C. Chapter 35
notes: Establishes federal information security requirements. Mandates NIST to develop standards and guidelines for federal information systems.

derives_from.section: Art. I, § 8, cl. 18; Art. IV, § 3, cl. 2
derives_from.note: Necessary & Proper Clause (Art. I § 8 cl. 18) for legislating on federal information-system administration; Property Clause (Art. IV § 3 cl. 2) for governance of federal information assets as government property.
